context: Grades the protect-main-branch hook's Bash analysis: six simulated Bash payloads against a main checkout are recorded, with git push and branch deletion denied, .git tampering denied, and read-only git, git checkout -b and non-git commands deliberately allowed.

checklist.name: All six cases recorded
checklist.description: record/cases/<id>/ holds exit-code, stdout.txt, stderr.txt and verdict for status, push, branch-delete, gitdir-tamper, create-branch and foreign-write.

checklist.name: Exit contract holds everywhere
checklist.description: Every recorded exit-code is 0; denial is only ever signalled via stdout permissionDecision, never by exit code.

checklist.name: Push denied
checklist.description: push/stdout.txt parses with jq as hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision "deny", reason mentioning git push.

checklist.name: Branch deletion denied
checklist.description: branch-delete/stdout.txt carries a deny permissionDecision clearly caused by a branch-write (deletion) rule, not a generic message.

checklist.name: .git tampering denied
checklist.description: gitdir-tamper/stdout.txt carries a deny decision with a reason about shell writes under .git/.

checklist.name: Read-only git allowed
checklist.description: status/verdict is allow with no hookSpecificOutput JSON in stdout.txt.

checklist.name: Branch creation allowed
checklist.description: create-branch/verdict is allow with no deny JSON, matching the documented deliberate carve-out for checkout -b.

checklist.name: Non-git write allowed
checklist.description: foreign-write/verdict is allow with no deny JSON, matching the documented pass-through for commands the parser does not treat as git writes.

checklist.name: Log distinguishes denied cases
checklist.description: record/protect-main-branch.log shows PROTECTED BRANCH VIOLATION entries for exactly the three denied cases.

checklist.name: Summary names deliberate allows
checklist.description: record/summary.txt's six id:verdict lines match recorded behaviour and the final lines name create-branch and foreign-write as deliberate allows.
